title: U.S. House · Illinois's 13th District
area: East-central Illinois, including Springfield, Champaign-Urbana, and parts of the Metro East (Belleville area).

context.text: Incumbent Nikki Budzinski defeated Dylan Blaha in the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary, 75.1% to 24.9%. Jeff Wilson ran unopposed for the Republican nomination.

candidates.name: Nikki Budzinski
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary with 75.1% of the vote

summary.text: Nikki Budzinski is the Democratic U.S. Representative for Illinois's 13th District, first elected in 2022. She previously served as chief of staff of the federal Office of Management and Budget and as a senior advisor in the Office of the Governor of Illinois.

background.text: Born in Peoria, Illinois; earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
Worked on the campaigns of Chris Dodd, Hillary Clinton, and J.B. Pritzker.
Served as chief of staff of the federal Office of Management and Budget and as a senior advisor with the Office of the Governor of Illinois, where she chaired the Broadband Advisory Council.
President of Budzinski & Partners, LLC, a political consulting firm.

record.text: In the 119th Congress (2025-2026), serves on the Committee on Agriculture (Commodity Markets, Digital Assets and Rural Development; Conservation, Research and Biotechnology; General Farm Commodities, Risk Management and Credit) and the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs (Technology Modernization).

candidates.name: Jeff Wilson
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary unopposed

summary.text: Jeff Wilson is the Republican nominee for Illinois's 13th Congressional District. He is a U.S. Navy veteran who has been affiliated with the Champaign County Board.

background.text: Has been affiliated with the Champaign County Board.

researchNotes: Neither candidate has completed the 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey and no campaign websites with stated priorities or issue positions were found for either within the research budget for this race; Jeff Wilson's public record beyond his Navy service and county board affiliation is limited.
